title.narrative: East Asia and the Pacific Justice for the Poor Initiative

description.narrative:
"World Bank and AusAID actively support justice sector reform programs in the East Asia and Pacific region. The Justice for the Poor (J4P) Initiative will support projects that deal with theoretical and practical challenges of promoting pro-poor justice reform in the developing world. J4P projects will study process oriented solutions to development challenges that will result in a profound understanding of how equitable legal and regulatory systems emerge. J4P will draw upon AusAID's vast justice sector reform experience in the region, as well as the Bank's experience.
The program is designed to strengthen and expand existing J4P programs in the region (Cambodia and Indonesia) and develop a number of new country programs (Timor-Leste, Vanuatu and the Solomon Islands, possibly Fiji and PNG as well as other). J4P is directly mentioned in the country CASs in those countries where it is already operating and is being incorporated into the pacific regional strategy this year.
The overall goal of the East Asia and the Pacific Justice for the Poor Initiative is to: o Support local justice and governance reform efforts by providing assistance to specific country initiatives and by facilitating regional knowledge sharing and cross-country learning; and o Improve donor understanding and approaches to supporting justice/governance reform, drawing on lessons learned from country and regional experiences."
